_comment: Failure labels (findings.py) the requirement-severity tests are known to fail with at commit 3164e825.
Used only with PPDS_DIFF_XFAIL=1: a test whose failures all carry these labels is reported as xfail.
A failure with any other label, or 'unlabelled', still fails. Remove a label when its fix lands.

labels.r2-switch-colon: round 2 must-fix (A2, B1): env select --environment:<unlisted> / -env:<unlisted> passes
labels.r2-bare-start: round 2 must-fix (A3, B2): the CLI started with no arguments (TUI) passes both gates
labels.r2-sql-leading-comment: round 2 must-fix (B3): query sql text starting with a -- comment line hides a write
labels.r2-sql-glued-write-word: round 2 must-fix (B4): a write word glued to a literal (SELECT 1DELETE ...)
labels.r2-dry-run-swallowed: round 2 must-fix (B5): --dry-run consumed as the value of another option
labels.r2-read-only-swallowed: round 2 must-fix (B6): --read-only consumed as the value of an MCP server option
labels.r2-response-file-in-env-gate: round 2 should-fix (A note, B should-fix 4): a response file passes the env gate
labels.new-switch-delimiter-then-space: found by oracle 1: env select --environment= <unlisted> (delimiter, then the value as the next word)
labels.new-env-wrapper-here-string: found by oracle 2: env FOO=1 bash <<< '$(echo ppds) <write>' passes every mode
labels.new-switch-behind-runtime-program: found by oracle 2: a switch behind a program word known only at run time, after a runner (timeout 5 `echo ppds` env select ...), passes the listed-env gate
labels.new-switch-args-from-elsewhere: found by oracle 2: a switch whose words come from xargs passes the listed-env gate
